comment:
* Class for a fast event queue.
     *
     * If we keep at least one node in the list then it can be atomic
     * and non-blocking.

variables.name: mFirst
variables.comment: One thread takes from the beginning of the list.

variables.name: mLast
variables.comment: A second thread returns events to the end of the list.

methods.name: public SchedulableEvent remove()
methods.comment:
* Do not call this unless there is more than one event
         * in the list.
         * @return first event in the list
